name: Critter Sitters
headline:
Pet sitting in
Fort Wayne, with daily photo updates.
leadText: Critter Sitters at 716 Kinnaird Ave, Fort Wayne. Dogs, cats and small animals, looked after by a sitter neighbors recommend on Nextdoor.
reviews: She sends pics of the pups while you're away, she texts back quickly, and my dogs are happy/rested/good mannered when I pick them up.

She did an amazing job with our zoo (8 cats, a foster dog, fish, and our bearded dragon). She sent daily updates (with pictures), was super responsive, took great care of our house (she even took care of our plants).

Extremely knowledgeable about many different types of animals and aspects of their care. Flexible with scheduling, and extremely reliable AND dependable. No matter the size of your pet big OR small the amount of love given to them is always equal.
